recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban collage centered on a halftone-textured female figure, framed by elements of a US banknote including guilloché patterns, architectural engravings, and currency-inspired borders, utilizing a restricted palette of red, black, and aged paper cream.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject integrated into a central circular banknote frame
Red accent elements (hair, car, birds) contrasting with monochrome halftone
Hand-drawn graffiti-style lettering layered over formal currency engraving
Juxtaposition of luxury symbols (sports car, crown) with suburban architecture
coreInvariants: Halftone dot pattern on all photographic elements
Aged, textured paper background with visible fiber and creases
Strict three-color hierarchy: Cream, Black, and Vibrant Red

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central full-body portrait, scaled to dominate the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the circular currency frame behind her.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red hair, moves down the body to the red car, then circles back through the peripheral red birds and large-scale typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with overlapping textures and secondary graphic elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red (hair, clothing accents, birds, and primary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between deep blacks and light cream; red is highly saturated to pop against the desaturated background.
paletteRestrictions: No blues or greens except for subtle aged-ink oxidation effects
Pure white is avoided in favor of cream

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Aggressive, gestural brush script and heavy block serifs
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Hand-painted, dripping brush strokes with varying thickness
Secondary text: Wide, heavy slab serifs with internal engraving lines
Metadata: Clean, sans-serif capitals for small technical details
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title overlap and vary in baseline height
Currency-style text follows the curve of the banknote ribbons
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive gestural script paired with rigid, formal currency-style slab serifs.

preserve: The hand-painted feel of the red text
The currency-style engraving of the bottom text
avoid: Clean, modern sans-serifs for main titles

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, energetic feel of the primary display text
Provides the necessary weight for the currency-inspired footer

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a digital collage on aged cream paper. Include a central halftone portrait of a woman with red hair, a red sports car at her feet, and a suburban house behind her. Frame the scene with US dollar bill engraving patterns, including a circular frame and ornate borders. Add two red cardinal birds in the periphery.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, hand-painted red brush-script lettering in the top left. Add a curved ribbon at the bottom with heavy, engraved slab-serif text. Place a small red stamp-style block of text in the upper right.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern consistent across all photographic elements?
Does the red color maintain the same saturation across the hair, car, and text?
Are the currency borders properly aligned with the edges?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the primary script text
Complexity of the guilloché border patterns
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the car or clothing
Specific facial features to ensure a unique character
Exact currency denominations or serial numbers
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'muddy' colors; ensure the red stays vibrant.
Verify that the halftone dots don't disappear in small areas.
Ensure the text feels integrated into the collage, not just floating on top.
Confirm the background texture looks like physical paper.
Check that the engraving lines follow the perspective of the objects.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject] with [Currency Motif] using [Halftone Texture] and a [Red/Black/Cream] palette, featuring [Gestural Script] overlays.
